title: Remove the Feedback Hub app (Store package Microsoft.FeedbackHub)
description: Removes the Feedback Hub Store package (Microsoft.FeedbackHub) for the current user. The package is reinstallable from the Microsoft Store. On undo the package is re-registered from its install location when the files are still on disk; if they are gone, the undo result carries the documented winget identifier and the post-undo verification reports honestly that restoration was not possible.
